title: Electrical Invoice Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Bill an electrical job from your browser: labor by license level, panel work, permits. No sign-up. PDF, Word and Excel, with US price ranges and sources.
lede_html: Enter the job in the form and download an electrical invoice as a PDF, Word or Excel file. There is no account. The sample is a GFCI and circuit job. Overwrite it.

sample.pay: Bank transfer or check to Brightline Electric
sample.terms: City permit EP-00000 closed after inspection. Labor warranty: 1 year.

must_show.heading: What to show on an electrical invoice
must_show.intro_html: An electrical invoice shows who did the work under which license, what changed in the panel or circuit, and which permit covers it.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on electrical work
rows: Most states require electricians to be licensed.
The number lets the owner find the record.
Apprentice, journeyman and master rates differ, so each gets a line.
Amps, breaker and room make the later service call shorter.
The form can tax parts only, or all.
Say how long your labor warranty runs.

example.heading: Filled example: 200 A panel replacement
example.after_html: Housecall Pro lists $2,250–$5,100 for a 30-circuit, 200-amp load center job.

line_items.heading: Electrical line items and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.

items.name: Replace an indoor receptacle with GFCI
Microwave outlet with dedicated 20 A circuit

line_items.after_html: For scale: the median pay of US electricians was $30.38 per hour in May 2025 (BLS). That is wage, not the rate you bill.

rules.heading: Electrical rules that touch the invoice

items.title: Texas license
items.html: Texas generally requires a Chapter 1305 license for electrical work. Licensed plumbers may disconnect or reconnect plumbing fixtures and appliances on existing circuits, but may do no other electrical work.

items.title: Washington permits
items.html: Electrical work there needs a permit and an inspection, with a few exceptions. Put the permit number in the notes field.

items.title: Local inspection
items.html: Texas TDLR does not inspect for local permits. The local authority does. Name the city or county on your invoice.

faq.q: Should I bill a flat rate or hourly?
faq.a: Both work on this form. Enter one job line with quantity 1 for a flat rate, or enter hours and an hourly rate per license level.

faq.q: Do I list the breaker and wire on the invoice?
faq.a: List them if the customer asks. For a small repair, you can use one materials line.

faq.q: What if a permit fee changes after the estimate?
faq.a: Bill the real fee on its own line and keep the receipt from the city.

faq.q: Can I show an apprentice and a journeyman on one job?
faq.a: Give each person a line with hours and rate.
